found.description: False when the photos hold no recipe, or a recipe that cannot be read usefully. Every other field is then empty.

name.description: The dish, without the version, for example Pancakes.

description.description: One or two sentences about the dish.

name.description: What sets this way of making it apart, for example Buttermilk.

description.description: One or two sentences about this version.

ingredients.description: Every ingredient in printed order, with groups such as For the sauce merged into one list.

quantity.description: Fractions as decimals, so 1 1/2 is 1.5. The lower number of a range. Null when there is no amount.

toTaste.description: True for to taste, or when no amount is given.

steps.description: Every method step in order, without its number.

matchId.description: The catalog id of the published recipe that these photos are a version of, or null.

matchReason.description: One short sentence on why, or null.

otherRecipes.description: Names of any other recipes the photos show.

sourceLanguage.description: The language of the photos when it is not English, for example Italian. Null for English.

kind.description: estimate: not printed, judged from the recipe. unclear: hard to read or ambiguous. written: text the photos do not contain.

reason.description: A few words for the cook, for example Printed as 2 to 3.
